newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank/Portugal-CPI to rise yr/yr 2.0% to end Q3.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Portugal-CPI to rise yr/yr 2.0% to end Q3.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal said it expected Portugal's year-on-year inflation rate to be around two percent through to the end of the third quarter of 1997.

Analysts have forecast that the rate, which stood at 2.5 percent in March, could fall to or below two percent in April and May as meat prices, which surged last year on the mad cow scare, drop out of the index.
The Bank gave no forecast for April inflation in its latest quarterly report but it said that there would be a sharp fall from March.
The end of the one-off statistical factors would lead to a rise in the year-on-year rate in the last quarter of the year, the Bank said.
